preprocessing_specification.normalization: Standardization strictly using TRAIN split valid pixels (DN > 0)

governance_and_firewall_rules.clustering: GOV-RULE-077 (Mission datatake clustering to prevent along-track pseudo-replication)
governance_and_firewall_rules.partitioning: GOV-RULE-075 (Pre-slice parent clustering before spatial slicing)
governance_and_firewall_rules.qc_standard: GOV-RULE-079 (Four distinct QC layers: Technical, Provenance, Semantic, Independence)
governance_and_firewall_rules.holdout_firewall: HOLDOUT is strictly quarantined from development, training, tuning, and threshold selection.

known_scientific_limitations.single_archive_grounding: 100% of samples are derived from the Li IW archive; this provides independent acquisitions but not multi-source benchmark diversity.

sparse_classes.HM: 14 parent clusters (8 TRAIN, 3 DEV, 3 HOLDOUT), 1,847 total valid pixels. Minimally usable for representation; inadequate for strong generalization claims.
sparse_classes.OF: 7 parent clusters (4 TRAIN, 1 DEV, 2 HOLDOUT), 33,706 valid pixels. Scientifically weak for robust boundary generalization.

known_scientific_limitations.georeferencing: Relative pixel grid alignment is strongly supported; absolute geocoding in GeoTIFF headers is an engineering placeholder transform.
